result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: missing Orders tab icon in bottom navigation, inconsistent wishlist heart styling, and lower content clipped by tab bar.

issues.description: Orders tab in bottom navigation shows label but no visible icon, while Home, Search and Profile all show icons above labels
issues.suggestion: Verify Orders icon asset is loading and apply same size, color and opacity as other inactive tabs

issues.description: Wishlist heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card lacks the dark circular scrim/background that is visible behind heart on pizza card below, looking inconsistent and low-contrast
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent circular background/scrim to all favorite icons for visibility and visual consistency

issues.description: Second card under Popular right now is cut off flush against top edge of bottom tab bar with no bottom padding, hiding restaurant name and details
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset to scroll container so last cards are fully visible above tab bar
